AdminUser.title: AdminUser
AdminUser.description: Authorized store owner, admin, merchant, or revoked access record in the admins collection keyed by Firebase Authentication UID. The initial owner (UID: VrLNKE3naCXN34GDog4tejrwPO13, email: kunalkushwaha969@gmail.com) is immutable and cannot be demoted or deleted by other admins.

uid.description: Firebase Authentication UID matching document ID

role.description: Authorization role granting full admin control, merchant access, or explicit revocation (including owner handover)

displayName.description: Optional display name of the user

approved_by.description: Email or UID of the Admin who updated this role

handover_to_uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the verified active Admin receiving website control when the initial owner revokes their own access

created_at.description: ISO timestamp when record was created

updated_at.description: ISO timestamp when role was last updated

RegisteredUser.title: RegisteredUser
RegisteredUser.description: Registered user account profile awaiting or holding merchant/admin authorization, keyed by Firebase Authentication UID. Contains no role or privilege fields.

uid.description: Firebase Authentication UID matching document ID

updated_at.description: ISO timestamp of latest profile sync

/admins/{adminUid}.description: Firebase-managed admin, merchant, and revoked role registry keyed by Firebase Auth UID

/users/{userUid}.description: Registered accounts directory keyed by Firebase Auth UID for Admin approval in User Management
